integrity: The proof is analytic and self-contained after the definition and monotonicity of the generalized mean. No numerical experiment or external certificate is used as a proof step.
scientific_limitations: The theorem is for real \(\ell_1(I)\) only. Full text of Tang–Ji–Wang (2004) was unavailable, so possible overlap at the \(t=-\infty\) endpoint remains a residual literature risk; the unified all-parameter profile was compared directly with the 2023 defining article and current published-result searches.
title: Exact pointwise James type profile of real \(\ell_1(I)\)
